desc: The Breakthrough Clean Technologies Rust Removeris a powerful solution designed to tackle rust and corrosion efficiently. Ideal for both precise and soaking applications, this fast-acting formula begins working in as little as 10 minutes, with the option for deeper cleaning through extended soaking of up to 6 hours. Safe for use on plastic, PVC, Viton, and most paints, it ensures versatile application across various surfaces. The water-based formula is reusable for multiple soaking applications and requires proper disposal according to local laws. Proudly made in the USA, this rust remover is your go-to solution for effective and reliable rust management.
